_comment: Pterodactyl egg for Bedrokia Proxy - a NetherNet proxy for Bedrokia servers (https://github.com/Nexiumpvp2/bedrokia-proxy)
name: Bedrokia Proxy
author: nexiumpvp2@users.noreply.github.com
description: Bedrokia Proxy: players join it and play on the Bedrokia servers behind it, switching server without reconnecting (like WaterdogPE). Xbox Live is always checked by the proxy. Players join through NetherNet (WebRTC) on the main port (TCP + UDP). The servers behind it are listed in servers.properties (file manager), reloaded as soon as it is saved.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Bedrokia Proxy install script: downloads the Linux proxy from the GitHub releases.
# The repository is private: the API needs a token (GITHUB_TOKEN) to download a release asset.
command -v curl >/dev/null || { apt update && apt install -y curl ca-certificates; }

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

REPO="Nexiumpvp2/bedrokia-proxy"
AUTH=()
[ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN}" ] && AUTH=(-H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}")
if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    RELEASE="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/latest"
else
    RELEASE="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/tags/${VERSION}"
fi

echo "Looking for the release: ${RELEASE}"
JSON=$(curl -fsSL "${AUTH[@]}" "${RELEASE}") || { echo "Release not found: check GITHUB_TOKEN (private repository) and VERSION"; exit 1; }
# Asset JSON: "url", "id", "node_id", "name"... (no object between url and name).
ASSET=$(echo "${JSON}" | tr -d '\n' | grep -o '"url": *"[^"]*/releases/assets/[0-9]*"[^}]*"name": *"bedrokia-proxy"' | grep -o 'https://[^"]*/releases/assets/[0-9]*' | head -1)
[ -n "${ASSET}" ] || { echo "The release has no bedrokia-proxy file"; exit 1; }

echo "Downloading ${ASSET}"
curl -fsSL "${AUTH[@]}" -H "Accept: application/octet-stream" -o bedrokia-proxy "${ASSET}" || { echo "Download failed"; exit 1; }
chmod +x bedrokia-proxy

# The panel fills these keys at each start; the proxy adds the other ones with comments.
if [ ! -f proxy.properties ]; then
    printf 'server-port=%s\nwebrtc-ports=%s\n' "${SERVER_PORT}" "${WEBRTC_PORTS}" > proxy.properties
fi
echo "Bedrokia Proxy installed. Put your servers in servers.properties (created at the first start)."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: Release to install: latest, or a tag such as v0.1.0.

variables.name: GitHub token
variables.description: Token that can read the private repository Nexiumpvp2/bedrokia-proxy (fine-grained: Contents read-only). Empty if the repository is public.

variables.name: WebRTC UDP ports
variables.description: auto = every player on the main port (TCP + UDP). Or a range like 25600-25630 to give each player a port of its own (all of them must then be allocations of this server).
